item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["9876939dd068278ba04c","6e8b7e77cf2071ee6c54"],"operation":"Parse XML with XML_PARSE_DTDVALID.","condition":"An input requests DTD validation.","capability":"Preserve XML_PARSE_DTDVALID through the harness options so the parser can validate against a DTD.","consequence":"Clearing the bit makes option selected DTD validation unreachable.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe the same validation option, trigger, capability, and consequence."},{"member_ids":["a0aad377ffd10bc3a708","459499caa119687cc395"],"operation":"Parse XML with XML_PARSE_NO_XXE.","condition":"An input selects XML_PARSE_NO_XXE.","capability":"Pass XML_PARSE_NO_XXE to the parser to suppress external DTD and entity loading.","consequence":"If the option cannot be selected, that suppression cannot be requested.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe selection of the same option for the same external content behavior."},{"member_ids":["434d6f40871d96e55351"],"operation":"Parse and validate XML with XML_PARSE_DTDVALID and XML_PARSE_NO_XXE together.","condition":"An input requests DTD validation while disabling external content loading.","capability":"Preserve both XML_PARSE_DTDVALID and XML_PARSE_NO_XXE so validation can run with external loading suppressed.","consequence":"Clearing XML_PARSE_DTDVALID prevents the combined behavior.","equivalence_reason":"The required combination differs from either single option operation."}]}
